Our belief

At Gotham Lighting, we believe the right illumination can transform any space into a sanctuary of comfort, productivity, or inspiration. Every product is crafted in harmony with design, functionality, and sustainability.

01
Logo

The mark of light.

Our logo is the most recognizable part of our identity. Use only the approved artwork from the master file, and give it room to breathe.

Primary logo

Mark and wordmark, together.

The full-color horizontal logo pairs the Gotham Red mark with the wordmark in Gray. It is the first choice for every application.

Clear space

Room to breathe.

Keep a clear zone around the logo equal to the height of the “o” in the wordmark. No type, imagery, or graphics should enter this space.

Minimum size

Always legible.

Never reproduce the horizontal logo smaller than 1.25 inches wide, or the stacked logo smaller than 1 inch wide.

Reversed

Bold on red.

On Gotham Red or dark backgrounds, use the all-white version of the logo. The “g” knocks out of the mark so the background shows through.

Clear space = height of the “o”

Misuse

What not to do.

Protect the logo by never altering the artwork. These are the most common mistakes to avoid.

Digital applications

Use RGB or HEX values for screens, including web, email, social, and presentations.

Print applications

Use CMYK values for printed pieces such as takeaway cards and booth graphics. Match to Pantone when spot color is available.

03
Typography

Clean voice, classic accent.

Poppins is our everyday typeface for headlines and body copy. Vollkorn adds a refined, editorial accent. Arial stands in for PowerPoint and email.

ExperienceInnovation
The golden ratio

In a two-word headline, the main word is set at 1.618 times the size of the first word. Pair a light Poppins lead-in with a Vollkorn main word.

04
Graphic elements

Shapes drawn from the mark.

Background shapes echo the curves of the Gotham “g.” Icons combine a Gotham Red line with a soft Light Gray block.

05
Photography

Spaces, transformed.

Show the light, not just the fixture. Our imagery features real environments where illumination shapes how a space feels.

01

Light is the hero

Frame scenes around the glow, wash, and shadow that our products create.

02

Warm and inviting

Favor dusk and evening light, warm materials, and spaces that feel lived in.

03

Architectural clarity

Use strong, symmetrical compositions with clean lines and uncluttered framing.

Where light meets innovation.
